findings.message: The entry param pessoaOrganizacaoId (select:indicadoresAcessoPessoas, persisted) has no state and no selection method in the defs, and its organism is a highlights block, not a list. Added the persisted state pessoaOrganizacaoId, the public method selecionarPessoaOrganizacao(id | null) and the getter indicadoresAcessoPessoas, which picks the row of the loaded list pessoas with that id; an unresolved id publishes client.selectionInvalid in qryPessoasAguardandoLiberacaoError.

irPrepararEmpresa also lists the entry param docId of empresa, which this page does not hold, so only empresaId (the id of empresa) is carried. verPessoasOrganizacao and abrirPessoaParaLiberar carry empresaId and pessoaOrganizacaoId only when this page holds them.
public indicadoresAcessoPessoas is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
public pessoaOrganizacaoId is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
public selecionarPessoaOrganizacao is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
